file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for University of Aberdeen A100. This file does not replace the production admissions rules.

readiness.summary: Aberdeen can support eligibility guidance, a useful result card, historical admissions context and a research/FOI pre-interview score. It cannot yet support full official formula prediction or

known_components.description: Official course data records academic weighting at 30%, UCAT weighting at 20%, and interview weighting at 50% for offer selection.
FOI-verified Aberdeen UCAT decile mapping, raw points conversion and weighted UCAT formula are available for the UCAT component.
Research-team academic scoring models are available for A-level, Scottish, IB and partially for graduate applicants. These are not official-source or FOI verified.
The existing official 2025 SJT policy remains unchanged for Home applicants: SJT Band 4 is accepted and SJT is not used in scoring.

International applicants use a separate ranking pool with 30% academic weighting, 20% UCAT cognitive weighting, a maximum shortlist score of 50, SJT Bands 1–3 accepted and SJT Band 4 automatically rejected.

unknown_components: FOI or official source verification for the raw academic score table
Validated historical competitiveness bands by cycle and applicant group
official_formula_status.explanation: Aberdeen A100 remains unavailable for full official formula prediction. The UCAT decile mapping, raw points conversion and weighted UCAT formula are FOI verified. The existing Home SJT policy remains unchanged, while verified international evidence makes Band 4 an automatic interview rejection for international applicants. Research-team academic models are stored for prediction research, but academic scoring is not official-source or FOI verified. Interview calculation, offer ranking and wider tie-breakers remain incomplete.
official_formula_status.notes: Historical, FOI or team research data must not be treated as the official Aberdeen scoring formula unless the source is stored and verified.

official_formula_prediction.reason: The UCAT component is FOI verified and the SJT non-scoring policy is official-source verified, but the full official prediction formula remains unavailable because academic scoring, interview calculation, offer ranking and tie-breakers are not fully official-source or FOI verified.

estimated_historical_prediction.method: International applicants use the verified /2700 guidance bands in the separate international ranking pool. Existing Home applicant groups continue to use their unchanged historical UCAT comparison model. This is interview guidance and is not a full offer prediction.

bands.label: Very high risk / ambitious
criteria: Applicant UCAT is below the historical lowest actual UCAT invited to interview for the matching applicant group.
bands.interpretation: The applicant is below the published historical invited-to-interview range for that group. Treat as ambitious with very high risk.

bands.label: Ambitious
criteria: Applicant UCAT is at or above the historical lowest actual UCAT invited to interview but below the historical average UCAT invited to interview for the matching applicant group.
bands.interpretation: The applicant may be eligible and within the historical interviewed range, but UCAT is below the average interviewed benchmark. Treat as ambitious.

bands.label: Realistic
criteria: Applicant UCAT is around or near the historical average UCAT invited to interview for the matching applicant group.
bands.interpretation: The applicant is near the historical average interviewed UCAT benchmark. Treat as realistic historical context, not an official prediction.

bands.label: Strong / competitive
criteria: Applicant UCAT is above the historical average UCAT invited to interview for the matching applicant group.
bands.interpretation: The applicant is above the historical average interviewed UCAT benchmark. Treat as strong historical context, not an official prediction.
